title: Merge Overlapping Ranges
constraints: Intervals touching at one endpoint are merged.

solutionApproaches.title: Repeatedly Compare Every Pair
solutionApproaches.explanation: Merge discovered overlaps in repeated passes; correct but unnecessarily slow and harder to reason about.

solutionApproaches.title: Sort and Sweep
solutionApproaches.complexity: Time O(n log n), Space O(n) for output
solutionApproaches.explanation: Sort by start, then extend the latest merged interval whenever the next range overlaps it.
